name: realtime
description: Realtime web interactions using Socket.IO/WebSocket-style transport with explicit connection lifecycle.
guidelines: Authenticate realtime connections when they expose user-specific state.
Define event names/payloads centrally enough to avoid client/server drift.
Handle reconnect and disconnected states in the UI.
Use Redis/pubsub when multiple workers/processes require cross-process fanout.
definition_of_done: Client can connect/reconnect without duplicating state.
Unauthorized clients cannot subscribe to private user data.
